subject: Launch request: Platform infrastructure backfill and interview coordination

Subject: Request to launch backfill search for Platform infra engineer

Hi Chloe/Laura —

We need to open a backfill req for the Platform Infrastructure engineer role (Rohan is leaving at end of month). Attached is an updated JD (JD_Platform_Infrastructure_v2.pdf) with a slightly broadened scope to include runtime reliability.

Key asks:
- Headcount approval to post and engage agencies/LinkedIn.
- Budget band confirmation (I recommend L4-L5 band).
- Approval to start scheduling interviews if we get qualified candidates early next week.

Tentative timeline: post this week, first screens week of July 20, on-site loop by early August.

Attaching JD for reference.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference

Thanks Dev —

Broad thumbs-up from my side to move forward, but we need formal greenlight from Markus for the headcount and banding before we engage paid agencies. Laura, can you confirm org capacity (replacement vs upgrade)?

If Markus signs off, I'll:
- Approve req to be created in the HR system and share the req link with the hiring panel.
- Draft an interview panel schedule template and proposed rubric for screens + onsite.
- Coordinate with Dev to prioritize internal referrals and our top agency.

Also please add any urgency note for Rohan's handover — we should have overlap hiring if possible.

-Chloe

On Mon, Jul 12, 2026 at 9:15 AM Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com> wrote:
> We need to open a backfill req for the Platform Infrastructure engineer role (Rohan is leaving at end of month).

Thanks for the heads-up. Approve opening the req. A few conditions:
- Post as L4 (Senior) by default to speed hiring; consider L5 only if an exceptional candidate surfaces.
- Compensation band: $170k–$210k base target depending on experience + RSU band per standard guideline.
- Please attach the completed req_form (REQ-4591) to the HR ticket; finance already cleared provisional bucket for this backfill.

Chloe — proceed with posting and initial outreach. Dev — you can engage agencies after posting. Keep me cc'd on any expedited offers.

-Markus Klein
VP Engineering | Redwood Inference

Chloe/Dev —

Confirming org preference: replace like-for-like (Senior) rather than up-leveling. Hiring quickly matters for operational coverage; please include a 2-week handover window with Rohan.

Dev — we have one promising inbound (Alex Singh, resume attached). Alex has experience in distributed KV caches and LLM runtime optimizations; looks like a good early-screen candidate. Can you reach out and offer a 30-min phone screen? I can do first- or second-round panels.

Also attaching the signed req form for HR (req_form_signed.pdf).

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
